visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair wearing a black t-shirt with white lettering patterns holds a vacuum-sealed plastic bag filled with orange-red broth and solid ingredients. The background is a clean indoor kitchen with white walls and cabinetry. (2) The man stands at a kitchen counter and pours the contents of the soup bag into a pink ceramic pot resting on a black gas stove. Steam rises as the broth hits the pot. (3) A close-up shot of the pink pot shows the soup base filled with various ingredients including lotus root slices, cubes of tofu, wood ear mushrooms, and round meatball-like objects. The lighting is bright and even. (4) The man holds up a bright yellow rectangular box with a red logo and black text that reads '18K金磚'. He brings the box close to his face, displaying a satisfied expression. (5) He shows a vacuum-packed block of dark, textured rice blood cakes. The camera focuses on the physical texture of the food through the plastic film. (6) The man uses yellow chopsticks to stir the pot, which now contains long yellow noodles and the previously shown rice blood cakes. The environment is well-lit studio-style kitchen lighting. (7) He sits at a low black table in a living room area with a grey fabric sofa and patterned cushions behind him. He holds a white bowl and uses chopsticks to eat a piece of the cooked ingredient. (8) The man pours a yellow canned beverage into a glass. On the table sits the pink pot and multiple bowls of food. (9) Close-up shots show him eating a porous, brown piece of 'Kao Fu' gluten, followed by him slurping noodles and sipping broth. He mops sweat from his forehead, indicating the heat of the food.

It utilizes a high-energy vlog style to demonstrate the convenience and rich ingredients of the product, aiming to drive viewers to the creator's IG bio link for a group buy purchase.
